caption: A cat nudges a pen off the edge of a desk with its paw and the pen falls to the floor.

sa.check: A cat and a pen are on a desk.
The cat nudges the pen with its paw toward the edge.
The pen goes over the edge and falls to the floor.
The nudge is made with a paw.
The nudge comes first and the fall follows.

pc.expect: The pen moves when the paw reaches it and only then, and it goes over once it is past the edge.
pc.fail: The pen starts moving before the paw reaches it; or the paw pushes the pen and the pen stays where it is; or the pen leaves the desk with the paw never touching it.

pc.expect: Once past the edge the pen tips and drops, falling quicker as it goes, and lands on the floor.
pc.fail: The pen hangs in the air past the edge of the desk; or it drifts outward while staying level with the desk top; or it rises after leaving the desk.

pc.expect: On the desk the pen moves only where it is pushed; on the floor it comes to rest and stays.
pc.fail: The pen slides across the desk with nothing touching it; or it rolls off on its own before the cat reaches it; or it sets off again once it has settled on the floor.

pc.expect: The pen stays a rigid stick as it falls and lands, clattering on the floor.
pc.fail: The pen bends like rope as it falls; or it splashes where it lands; or it flattens against the floor and stays flat.

pc.expect: The pen, the cat, the desk and the floor stay solid and keep their number.
pc.fail: The pen vanishes on the way down or a second one appears; or the pen passes through the desk top or the floor; or the paw passes through the pen.

pc.expect: The pen's colour, the cat's markings and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: The pen changes colour or length; or the cat's markings change between frames; or the things on the desk rearrange.

note: The cat is kept as the minimal trigger for the fall; its gait, posture and whether it looks at the pen are not judged.
